content: The safest extension seams are kyctl control-plane request/response types for capabilities and structured selection, kyclient desktop player alias/adapter for a native macOS player, kyclient winit/macOS input hooks, and kynput macOS pipeline configuration for NSPasteboard. The Kymux typed endpoints already expose AVPacket and InputPacket APIs, so no kyproto, kynet, kycom, or wire-format modification is required.
